prompt:
The section file sections/video-feature.liquid renders a featured video. The markup is correct and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. It hides the whole section when section.settings.video_url is null or an empty string. It hides the heading when section.settings.heading is null or empty. Only the {% schema %} JSON is wrong. Replace it with exactly this schema, keeping keys in this order.

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Video"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section-video"
- "settings": an array of exactly three settings, in this order:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Featured video". The default must be a non-empty string, not "".
  2. type "video_url", id "video_url", label "Video URL", accept ["youtube", "vimeo"] in that order, info "Leave empty to hide the section." This setting must have NO default key, so that it is null until a merchant picks a video. An empty-string default is wrong.
  3. type "checkbox", id "autoplay", label "Autoplay", default false (a JSON boolean).
- "presets": [{"name": "Video"}]

There must be no other keys: no blocks, no max_blocks, and no extra settings. Change only sections/video-feature.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
